_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS AN ANNOTATION ATTRIBUTE IS READ AS XML — run it from
the repository root:
cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/injection-harness/Cargo.toml -- sweep \
crates/mnemosyne-cli/sweeps/inventory-marker.sweep.json
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. `inventory_attributes` declares the XML attribute an
adopter annotates a document with — a namespace URI, a local name, and the
extensions whose documents carry it — and the axis parses such a document and
reads that attribute's value as a whitespace-separated list of inventory ids.
Round 1322 read it as a prefix plus a character class (the first id of a list
only); Round 1323 as text between two delimiters, a second grammar for what
the document's own XML already defines.
NINE INJECTIONS ON THE READER. Matching an attribute by local name alone is
the prefix-versus-namespace confusion; reading the raw text instead of the
parsed value is the entity that never decodes; dropping an unreadable document
in the extractor, in the scan, or dropping the parser's reason are the three
ways the silence this axis refuses could come back; skipping the attribute
axis in the one reader, or handing it the comment-stripped text, are how a
caller loses it; parsing a document of any extension reads examples as
citations; and an id that carries its attribute's line rather than its own
points a reader at the wrong line of a multi-line list.
THE DECLARATION'S OWN REFUSALS are swept next door, in
crates/mnemosyne-config/sweeps/inventory-attribute-declaration.sweep.json,
because they compile one crate rather than three.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record
beside this file.

injections.name: an-attribute-is-matched-by-local-name-alone
injections.why: the prefix-versus-namespace confusion the axis exists to remove: any attribute spelled `req` is read, whatever namespace its prefix is bound to

injections.name: a-value-is-read-as-raw-text
injections.why: the raw attribute text read instead of the value XML defines, so an id written through an entity never decodes — the residue Round 1323 stated and this round closed

injections.name: an-unreadable-document-is-skipped-by-the-extractor
injections.why: a document that does not parse read as citing nothing — indistinguishable from a document that cites nothing

injections.name: the-scan-drops-an-unreadable-document
injections.why: the extractor returns it and the gate never turns it into a violation — the same silence one layer up

injections.name: the-parser-reason-is-dropped
injections.why: the violation says a document did not parse and not why, so a consumer re-parses the file to learn what the gate saw

injections.name: the-one-reader-skips-the-attribute-axis
injections.why: the shape a caller that did not take the one reader would have: the axis is declared, parsed and echoed, and no citation under it is ever read

injections.name: the-attribute-axis-reads-what-comment-stripping-left
injections.why: an XML parser handed the comment-stripped text, which is not a document — the reason the one reader takes both the raw file and the stripped text

injections.name: a-document-of-any-extension-is-parsed
injections.why: every file in the read set parsed as XML, so a Markdown example becomes a citation and every source file becomes an unreadable document

injections.name: every-document-is-reported-as-carrying-the-attribute
injections.why: the coverage report says every document it read carries the attribute, so an adopter whose documents carry none of it is told the opposite of the truth

injections.name: a-document-that-carries-nothing-is-not-counted-as-read
injections.why: only documents that carry the attribute are counted as read, so `0 of 0` replaces `0 of N` and the report stops distinguishing a document read and found bare from a document never opened

injections.name: a-bare-document-is-counted-but-not-named
injections.why: the report says how many documents carry none of the attribute and never which, so an adopter reading it still has to search the tree for the ones written another way

injections.name: the-line-a-person-reads-omits-the-reach
injections.why: the wire says an attribute reached nothing and the line a person reads does not — the Round 1045 defect, one axis over

edits.from: " — NO DOCUMENT CARRIES IT, so this axis judged nothing"

injections.name: the-report-omits-the-attribute-axis
injections.why: the coverage is computed and never published, which is the silence this round exists to remove

injections.name: a-doctype-makes-a-document-unreadable
injections.why: the parser's default refusal of a DTD left in place, so an ordinary XML document carrying a document type declaration is reported unreadable instead of read

injections.name: the-walk-that-attributes-a-line-does-not-move-forward
injections.why: Round 1324's cursor: an id spelled through an entity leaves the walk where it was, so a later id whose text occurs inside that entity reference is reported on the entity's line

injections.name: an-id-carries-its-attributes-line-not-its-own
injections.why: every id of a multi-line list reported at the line the attribute opened on, which points a reader at a line the id is not on
